product_desc: Skingenetix Matrixyl 3000 Pro Collagen Firming Repair Serum: a 30ml frosted NEUTRAL WHITE glass dropper bottle, straight-sided with square shoulders, fitted with a brushed satin aluminium collar and a white rubber-bulb pipette. The glass is a clean cool white with no colour cast at all - never tinted teal, green, blue or grey. The collar metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY with a fine vertical brushed grain, never rose-gold, copper, champagne or a chrome mirror. PIPETTE PROPORTIONS: the white rubber bulb is an ELONGATED CAPSULE about 1.6 times taller than wide. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. The colour words below describe the INK each line is printed in and must never themselves appear as text on the product: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark in BLACK, spelled with a CAPITAL 'S' and the rest lower case, with no registered-trademark, copyright or any other symbol anywhere near it; a narrow vertical DEEP TEAL rule down the left of the text block; 'MATRIXYL 3000' on one line and 'PRO COLLAGEN' on the next, both in BLACK bold capitals; 'FIRMING REPAIR' on one line and 'TREATMENT' on the next, both in DEEP TEAL bold capitals; 'PREMIUM FORMULA' in MID-GREY capitals; and the fine print line '10% MATRIXYL | 30ML' in MID-GREY capitals. THE BOTTLE CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE - not the benefit words, not 'ALL SKIN TYPES', not any ingredient list. Those are carton-only. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: DEEP TEAL. Any brand colour, gradient or accent glow builds from that teal and cool neutrals - never gold, rose, purple, orange or blue.
_packaging_desc_help: The carton teal is a deep emerald-teal, sampled #205952 off the dieline, richer and darker than the label ink. The silver face is a matte-silk silver with the same wording in dark grey and teal.
packaging_desc: The product carton is a tall slim rectangular box, noticeably taller than it is wide, with crisp square edges and a matte finish. It has TWO different printed faces and both may appear: one face is a DEEP EMERALD-TEAL panel with a soft vertical gradient, the other is a MATTE-SILK SILVER panel - never mirror chrome, never foil-shiny. On the TEAL face, printed in WHITE: the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark and the 'Skingenetix' wordmark, then 'MATRIXYL 3000' and 'PRO COLLAGEN' in bold capitals, then 'FIRMING REPAIR' and 'TREATMENT', then the stacked words 'PLUMPING', 'FIRMING' and 'VOLUMIZING', then 'PREMIUM FORMULA', then 'ALL SKIN TYPES', and the fine print 'MATRIXYL 3000 | 3X PEPTIDES' above '4X HYALURONIC ACID | 50ML'. On the SILVER face the same wording appears with the headline lines in DARK GREY and 'FIRMING REPAIR TREATMENT' in DEEP TEAL. No colour name appears as text anywhere on the box.
